channel.title: Sample: Science
channel.description: Made-up sample stories for trying out the news reader. None of these companies or events are real.

item.title: Astronomers spot a comet that will be visible without a telescope next spring
item.description: The made-up comet, nicknamed 'Harper's Lantern', should be brightest in late April for viewers in the Northern Hemisphere.

item.title: Ocean robots map a coral reef in record time
item.description: A fleet of small, solar-powered boats surveyed the imaginary reef in four days instead of the usual six weeks.

item.title: New battery design uses salt instead of lithium
item.description: Researchers at the fictional Brookfield Institute say the cells are cheaper to make but heavier, making them better suited to homes than cars.

item.title: Why your houseplants lean towards the window
item.description: A short explainer on phototropism: how plants grow towards light, and how to keep them growing straight.

item.title: Citizen scientists log a million bird sightings in a single weekend
item.description: Volunteers across the country took part in the made-up survey using a free phone app.
